headline.text: L1 S2 jar line metal-in-product caught by X-ray but *missed by metal detector* — wire mesh investigation ongoing, MD verification every 30 min.

summary: One active hold — L2 FFS pallet with mixed lots 62C/62K isolated after changeover breach. L1 S2 metal detector failed to catch wire mesh fragment that X-ray rejected; broken enrober belt ran 2nd shift under heightened verification protocol.

holds.title: Mixed-lot pallet on hold after FFS changeover breach
holds.summary: Pallet containing mixed product from lots 62C and 62K isolated in hold area after lots were found mixed at Z-conveyor and scales during changeover.
holds.status: On hold in designated area pending disposition by QA.

food_safety.title: Metal detector failure on S2 jar line — X-ray caught, MD did not
food_safety.summary: X-ray rejected wire mesh fragment from broken enrober belt; metal detector did not detect the same piece, triggering investigation and 30-minute MD verification cycle.
food_safety.status: Open — MD verification every 30 min through end of 2nd shift, wire mesh piece confirmed rejected by MD in subsequent test, belt replaced on 3rd shift.

food_safety.title: Broken enrober wire mesh on S2 — ran under verification protocol
food_safety.summary: Wire mesh on S2 enrober broke; Production and QA agreed to continue running with operator stationed at enrober, photos every 30 min, and MD/X-ray checks every 30 min.
food_safety.status: Resolved — belt replaced during 3rd shift reheat at 01:04 MT, no further issues reported.

food_safety.title: S3 Z-conveyor belt splitting — product falling inside belt
food_safety.summary: Belt flap splitting along base, allowing pieces to fall inside belt with each rotation and causing buildup around bottom roller; belt flagged for ASAP replacement.
food_safety.status: Open — line continues running with periodic CILT cleaning of bottom roller; replacement belt availability being confirmed.

food_safety.title: Truffle line tunnel 3 missing 4 rollers — maintenance approved continued run
food_safety.summary: Broken roller to tunnel 3 identified; upon inspection, 4 rollers total confirmed missing; maintenance confident line can run without them, no replacements on site.
food_safety.status: Open — line running, replacements ordered, Kavin Ayala placing order with Jay.

quality.title: Two lot-mixing events on FFS in 12 hours
quality.summary: First event: box of 63 LUC mixed onto 63 JUC pallet, separated on 1st shift; second event: lots 62C and 62K mixed at Z-conveyor/scales during changeover on 3rd shift, pallet held.
quality.status: Resolved for first event; second event pallet on hold, QA requested documented process for staging multiple lots.

quality.title: ML2 code date printing errors during FEA China startup
quality.summary: Code date lines inverted and spacing incorrect on startup; required three rounds of adjustment before QA approved print consistency over 100-bar run.
quality.status: Resolved — print approved by QA at 02:37 MT after spacing and line order corrected.

quality.title: Checkweigher failure on MFM — caught immediately, no product affected
quality.summary: Checkweigher stopped detecting underweight pouches; operator caught issue immediately, line stopped, no low-weight pouches reached pallets.
quality.status: Resolved — issue corrected, line restarted, no hold required.

quality.title: S2 soft/runny caramel causing line stops
quality.summary: Caramel consistency issues on S2 causing multiple stops for investigation and scraper cleaning; settings verified unchanged from 1st shift start.
quality.status: Open — issue persists into 1st shift 7/31, Curt Willis engaged.

quality.title: Product from previous run found during MFM date change
quality.summary: Piece of Bequet chocolate from yesterday's run found during visual inspection for date change on MFM.
quality.status: Resolved — product removed, date changed, production continued.

sanitation.title: ML1 dirty mold alarms — chocolate buildup on hopper cover identified
sanitation.summary: Constant dirty-mold alarms on both north and south sides; inspection found heavy chocolate buildup on hopper cover contaminating mold pins; area cleaned.
sanitation.status: Resolved — hopper cover area cleaned, mold cleanliness improved.

sanitation.title: ML2 dirty molds replaced during 2nd shift FEA run
sanitation.summary: Heavily stained bars observed; QA requested dirty molds swapped for clean; 68 dirty molds replaced with clean, appearance improved.
sanitation.status: Resolved — molds replaced, product appearance within spec.

sanitation.title: Food product in L3 walkway
sanitation.summary: Ritz crackers found sitting in walkway; GMP violation flagged to Rose Smuin and Chad Stone.
sanitation.status: Open — reported to management for cleanup and root cause.

opportunities.text: Consider adding wire mesh inspection to S2 enrober startup checklist and defining MD verification frequency when running with damaged food-contact equipment — based on today's broken mesh event and initial MD failure to detect the fragment.
Review FFS lot-staging SOP and consider single-lot-at-a-time rule for Z-conveyor feed — based on two mixing events in 12 hours (63 LUC/JUC boxes, then 62C/62K at changeover).
Add hopper cover inspection to ML1 mold-cleaning protocol — based on today's discovery that chocolate buildup on the cover was root cause of persistent dirty-mold alarms.
